questions.question: On this day in 1856, King William III unilaterally modified the constitution of which European country to significantly expand his royal powers?
questions.explanation: As Grand Duke of Luxembourg, William III altered the nation's constitution on this date in 1856 to gain greater authority.
questions.context:
On this day in 1856: William III (pictured) unilaterally revised the constitution of Luxembourg, greatly expanding his powers as grand duke.
William III of the Netherlands (King of the Netherlands from 1849 to 1890): William III was King of the Netherlands and Grand Duke of Luxembourg from 1849 until his death in 1890, and was also the Duke of Limburg from 1849 until the abolition of the duchy in 1866.

questions.question: Before starring in films like St. Elmo's Fire and About Last Night..., which American actor came to prominence in the 1980s as a member of the 'Brat Pack'?
questions.explanation: Rob Lowe rose to fame as a teen idol in the 1980s through roles in classic Brat Pack films such as St. Elmo's Fire.
questions.context: Rob Lowe (American actor (born 1964)): Robert Hepler Lowe is an American actor and entertainment host. Following numerous television roles in the early 1980s, he came to prominence as a teen idol and member of the Brat Pack with starring roles in The Outsiders (1983), Class (1983), The Hotel New Hampshire (1984), Oxford Blues (1984), St. Elmo's Fire (1985), About Last Night... (1986), Youngblood (1986), Masquerade (1988), and Bad Influence (1990).

questions.question: Which English pop rock group was established in Birmingham in 1978 by Nick Rhodes, John Taylor, and Stephen Duffy?
questions.explanation: Duran Duran was originally formed in Birmingham in 1978 by Rhodes, Taylor, and Duffy before arriving at their famous line-up two years later.
questions.context: Duran Duran (English rock band): Duran Duran are an English pop rock band. They were formed in Birmingham in 1978 by keyboardist Nick Rhodes, guitarist John Taylor and singer/bassist Stephen Duffy. The band went through several early changes before the band's line-up settled in May 1980 as Rhodes, Taylor, singer Simon Le Bon, guitarist Andy Taylor and drummer Roger Taylor.

questions.question: American athlete Ezra Frech won the 35th season of Dancing with the Stars alongside dance partner Daniella Karagach in 2026. In which sport does he compete at the Paralympic Games?
questions.explanation: Ezra Frech is a Paralympic track and field athlete who gained gold medals in high jump, long jump, and sprint events.
questions.context: Ezra Frech (American Paralympic athlete (born 2005)): Ezra Frech is an American track and field athlete who competes in high jump, long jump and sprinting events. He is a two-time Paralympian, having competed at the 2020 Summer Paralympics and won two gold medals at the 2024 Summer Paralympics. He also won two silver medals at the 2019 Parapan American Games. Frech is a motivational speaker and disability rights advocate. In 2026, Frech won the thirty-fifth season of Dancing with the Stars, alongside his dance partner Daniella Karagach.

questions.question: Which country hosted the 75th Miss Universe pageant in November 2026 at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum?
questions.explanation: The 75th Miss Universe pageant was held in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
questions.context: Miss Universe 2026 (75th Miss Universe beauty pageant): Miss Universe 2026 was the 75th Miss Universe pageant, held at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on 24 November 2026. The event was presented by R'Bonney Gabriel, Mario Lopez, Zuri Hall, and Dayanara Torres.
